user_story: As a user, I want to be blocked from logging in if my account is locked so that security is enforced.

positive.title: Successful block from logging in with a locked account
steps: User attempts to log in with valid credentials.
User's account status is checked and found to be locked.
positive.expected_result: User is presented with a message indicating the account is locked and is denied access.

negative.title: Unsuccessful login attempt with incorrect credentials
steps: User attempts to log in with invalid credentials.
negative.expected_result: User is presented with a message indicating invalid credentials regardless of account status.

edge.title: Account locked after too many failed login attempts
steps: User attempts to log in with invalid credentials multiple times (more than limit).
User attempts to log in again with valid credentials.
edge.expected_result: User is presented with a message indicating the account is locked and is denied access.
